name: io.github.Furhworld/proxyclaw
description: Residential proxy tools with explicit V2 credentials; state/city selectors supported; exact-city accuracy varies.

environmentVariables.description: Legacy account key; V2 account key is separate from proxy authentication
environmentVariables.name: IPLOOP_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: V2 proxy username from platform.iploop.io; requires proxy password
environmentVariables.name: IPLOOP_PROXY_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: V2 proxy password; requires proxy username
environmentVariables.name: IPLOOP_PROXY_PASSWORD
